segments.name: Banking operations
segments.description: Provides retail and commercial banking services, including loans and deposit accounts, to businesses, professionals and consumers in Wisconsin and Illinois.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all of the financial service operations are considered by management to be aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers of the banking operation generate its significant revenues through loans, investments, service charges and deposits in other banks.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans, investments, service charges, and deposits in other banks provide the significant revenues in the banking operation.
